newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus Popular launches custody service.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus Popular launches custody service.

text.p: The Cyprus Popular Bank on Wednesday launched a securities custody service geared towards foreign and local investors on the Cyprus Stock Exchange.
"Many foreign investors consider the provision of a custody service in a company a basic requirement," said Marios Hadjigavriel, a member of the legal services department of the bank.
"This is sure to facilitate the attraction of foreign investors in Cyprus," he told a presentation of the new product in Nicosia.

The bank is offering safe custody of securities, the settlement of transactions, an information service to clients relating to their investments, the collection of income and dividends, monthly statements with reports of holdings and portfolio valuations and a proxy voting service.
Cyprus Popular, the second largest banking instutution on the island, is the first bank to offer such a service. HSBC has a 22 percent stake in the bank.
The bank has been the sub-custodian of Midland Bank in Cyprus since earlier this year.
"The Popular Bank was selected based on its proven ability to satisfy settlement and custody requirements," said Steve Faulkner, Network Manager of Midland Securities Services.
